pairs: O God, and despise not my supplication.
I have been grieved in my training,
at the voice of the adversary
and at the tribulation of the sinner.
For they have diverted iniquities toward me,
et in ira molesti erant mihi.
and they have been harassing me with rage.
Cor meum conturbatum est in me,
My heart has become disturbed within me,
et formido mortis cecidit super me.
and the dread of death has fallen over me.
Timor et tremor venerunt super me,
Fear and trembling have overwhelmed me,
Quis dabit mihi pennas sicut columbæ,
“Who will give me wings like the dove,
so that I may fly away
Behold, I have fled far away,
Exspectabam eum qui salvum me fecit a pusillanimitate spiritus,
I waited for him who saved me from a weak-minded spirit
quoniam vidi iniquitatem et contradictionem in civitate.
For I have seen iniquity and contradiction in the city.
ac nocte circumdabit eam super muros ejus iniquitas;
iniquity will surround it upon its walls,
and hardship is in its midst,
et non defecit de plateis ejus usura et dolus.
And usury and deceit have not fallen away from its streets.
Quoniam si inimicus meus maledixisset mihi,
For if my enemy had spoken evil about me, certainly,
Et si is qui oderat me super me magna locutus fuisset,
And if he who hated me had been speaking great things against me,
I would perhaps have hidden myself from him.
you are a man of one mind:
qui simul mecum dulces capiebas cibos;
who took sweet food together with me.
in domo Dei ambulavimus cum consensu.
In the house of God, we walked side-by-side.
and let them descend alive into Hellfire.
For there is wickedness in their dwellings,
But I have cried out to God,
and the Lord will save me.
and he will heed my voice.
Redimet in pace animam meam ab his qui appropinquant mihi:
He will redeem my soul in peace from those who draw near to me.
For, among the many, they were with me.
et humiliabit illos, qui est ante sæcula.
and He who is before time will humble them.
For there is no change with them,
and they have not feared God.
He has stretched forth his hand in retribution.
divisi sunt ab ira vultus ejus,
They were divided by the wrath of his countenance,
and his heart has drawn near.
Molliti sunt sermones ejus super oleum;
His words are smoother than oil,
Cast your cares upon the Lord,
non dabit in æternum fluctuationem justo.
He will not allow the just to be tossed about forever.
you will lead them away into the well of death.
Viri sanguinum et dolosi non dimidiabunt dies suos;
Bloody and deceitful men will not divide their days in half.
